Admin SDK lets administrators of enterprise domains to view and manage resources like user, groups etc. It also provides audit and usage reports of domain.
Operations on the 'activities' resource
Retrieves a list of activities for a specific customer's account and application such as the Admin console application or the Google Drive application.
Start receiving notifications for account activities. For more information, see Receiving Push Notifications.
Operations on the 'channels' resource
Stop watching resources through this channel.
Operations on the 'customerUsageReports' resource
Retrieves a report which is a collection of properties and statistics for a specific customer's account. For more information, see the Customers Usage Report guide.
Operations on the 'entityUsageReports' resource
Retrieves a report which is a collection of properties and statistics for entities used by users within the account. For more information, see the Entities Usage Report guide.
Operations on the 'userUsageReport' resource
Retrieves a report which is a collection of properties and statistics for a set of users with the account. For more information, see the User Usage Report guide.

The Google Chat API lets you build Chat apps to integrate your services with Google Chat and manage Chat resources such as spaces, members, and messages.
[Helper] Send a message to a space
Operations on the 'customEmojis' resource
Creates a custom emoji. Custom emojis are only available for Google Workspace accounts, and the administrator must turn custom emojis on for the organization.
Deletes a custom emoji. By default, users can only delete custom emoji they created. Emoji managers assigned by the administrator can delete any custom emoji in the organization.
Returns details about a custom emoji. Custom emojis are only available for Google Workspace accounts, and the administrator must turn custom emojis on for the organization.
Lists custom emojis visible to the authenticated user. Custom emojis are only available for Google Workspace accounts, and the administrator must turn custom emojis on for the organization.
Operations on the 'media' resource
Downloads media. Download is supported on the URI `/v1/media/{+name}?alt=media`.
Uploads an attachment. For an example, see Upload media as a file attachment.
Operations on the 'spaces' resource
Completes the import process for the specified space and makes it visible to users.
Creates a space. Can be used to create a named space, or a group chat in `Import mode`. For an example, see Create a space.
Deletes a named space. Always performs a cascading delete, which means that the space's child resources—like messages posted in the space and memberships in the space—are also deleted.
Returns the existing direct message with the specified user. If no direct message space is found, returns a `404 NOT_FOUND` error. For an example, see Find a direct message.
Returns all spaces with `spaceType == GROUP_CHAT`, whose human memberships contain exactly the calling user, and the users specified in `FindGroupChatsRequest.users`.
Returns details about a space. For an example, see Get details about a space.
Lists spaces the caller is a member of. Group chats and DMs aren't listed until the first message is sent. For an example, see List spaces.
Operations on the 'members' resource
Creates a membership for the calling Chat app, a user, or a Google Group. Creating memberships for other Chat apps isn't supported.
Deletes a membership. For an example, see Remove a user or a Google Chat app from a space.
Returns details about a membership. For an example, see Get details about a user's or Google Chat app's membership.
Lists memberships in a space. For an example, see List users and Google Chat apps in a space.
Updates a membership. For an example, see Update a user's membership in a space.
Operations on the 'messages' resource
Operations on the 'attachments' resource

commands.command: gws chat spaces messages attachments get
commands.summary: Gets the metadata of a message attachment. The attachment data is fetched using the media API. For an example, see Get metadata about a message attachment.
Creates a message in a Google Chat space. For an example, see Send a message.
Deletes a message. For an example, see Delete a message.
Returns details about a message. For an example, see Get details about a message.
Lists messages in a space that the caller is a member of, including messages from blocked members and spaces. System messages, like those announcing new space members, aren't included.
Updates a message. There's a difference between the `patch` and `update` methods. The `patch` method uses a `patch` request while the `update` method uses a `put` request.
Operations on the 'reactions' resource

commands.command: gws chat spaces messages reactions create
commands.summary: Creates a reaction and adds it to a message. For an example, see Add a reaction to a message.

commands.command: gws chat spaces messages reactions delete
commands.summary: Deletes a reaction to a message. For an example, see Delete a reaction.

commands.command: gws chat spaces messages reactions list
commands.summary: Lists reactions to a message. For an example, see List reactions for a message.
Updates a message. There's a difference between the `patch` and `update` methods. The `patch` method uses a `patch` request while the `update` method uses a `put` request.
Updates a space. For an example, see Update a space. If you're updating the `displayName` field and receive the error message `ALREADY_EXISTS`, try a different display name..
Returns a list of spaces in a Google Workspace organization. For an example, see Search for and manage spaces.
Creates a space and adds specified users to it. The calling user is automatically added to the space, and shouldn't be specified as a membership in the request.
Operations on the 'spaceEvents' resource
Returns an event from a Google Chat space. The event payload contains the most recent version of the resource that changed.
Lists events from a Google Chat space. For each event, the payload contains the most recent version of the Chat resource.
Operations on the 'users' resource
Operations on the 'sections' resource
Creates a section in Google Chat. Sections help users group conversations and customize the list of spaces displayed in Chat navigation panel. Only sections of type `CUSTOM_SECTION` can be created.
Deletes a section of type `CUSTOM_SECTION`. If the section contains items, such as spaces, the items are moved to Google Chat's default sections and are not deleted.
Operations on the 'items' resource

commands.command: gws chat users sections items list
commands.summary: Lists items in a section. Only spaces can be section items. For details, see Create and organize sections in Google Chat.

commands.command: gws chat users sections items move
commands.summary: Moves an item from one section to another. For example, if a section contains spaces, this method can be used to move a space to a different section.
Lists sections available to the Chat user. Sections help users group their conversations and customize the list of spaces displayed in Chat navigation panel.
Updates a section. Only sections of type `CUSTOM_SECTION` can be updated. For details, see Create and organize sections in Google Chat.
Changes the sort order of a section. For details, see Create and organize sections in Google Chat.
Operations on the 'spaces' resource
Returns details about a user's read state within a space, used to identify read and unread messages. For an example, see Get details about a user's space read state.
Operations on the 'spaceNotificationSetting' resource

commands.command: gws chat users spaces spaceNotificationSetting get
commands.summary: Gets the space notification setting. For an example, see Get the caller's space notification setting.

commands.command: gws chat users spaces spaceNotificationSetting patch
commands.summary: Updates the space notification setting. For an example, see Update the caller's space notification setting.
Operations on the 'threads' resource

commands.command: gws chat users spaces threads getThreadReadState
commands.summary: Returns details about a user's read state within a thread, used to identify read and unread messages. For an example, see Get details about a user's thread read state.
Updates a user's read state within a space, used to identify read and unread messages. For an example, see Update a user's space read state.

Creates an alias for a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to create the alias or for access errors.
Deletes an alias of a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to remove the alias or for access errors.

commands.command: gws classroom courses announcements addOnAttachments create

commands.command: gws classroom courses announcements addOnAttachments patch

Returns an announcement.

commands.summary: Creates course work. The resulting course work (and corresponding student submissions) are associated with the Developer Console project of the OAuth client ID used to make the request.
Deletes a course work. This request must be made by the Developer Console project of the OAuth client ID used to create the corresponding course work item.
Returns course work. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to access the requested course or course work, or for access errors.
Gets metadata for Classroom add-ons in the context of a specific post.
Returns a list of course work that the requester is permitted to view. Course students may only view `PUBLISHED` course work. Course teachers and domain administrators may view all course work.
Modifies assignee mode and options of a coursework. Only a teacher of the course that contains the coursework may call this method.
Updates one or more fields of a course work. See google.classroom.v1.CourseWork for details of which fields may be updated and who may change them.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork rubrics create
commands.summary: Creates a rubric. The requesting user and course owner must have rubrics creation capabilities. For details, see licensing requirements.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork rubrics delete
commands.summary: Deletes a rubric. The requesting user and course owner must have rubrics creation capabilities. For details, see licensing requirements.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork rubrics get
commands.summary: Returns a rubric. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` for access errors. * `INVALID_ARGUMENT` if the request is malformed.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork rubrics list
commands.summary: Returns a list of rubrics that the requester is permitted to view. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` for access errors.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork rubrics patch
commands.summary: Updates a rubric. See google.classroom.v1.Rubric for details of which fields can be updated. Rubric update capabilities are limited once grading has started.
Operations on the 'studentSubmissions' resource

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions get
commands.summary: Returns a student submission. * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to access the requested course, course work, or student submission or for access errors.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions list
commands.summary: Returns a list of student submissions that the requester is permitted to view, factoring in the OAuth scopes of the request.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions modifyAttachments
commands.summary: Modifies attachments of student submission. Attachments may only be added to student submissions belonging to course work objects with a `workType` of `ASSIGNMENT`.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions patch
commands.summary: Updates one or more fields of a student submission. See google.classroom.v1.StudentSubmission for details of which fields may be updated and who may change them.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions reclaim
commands.summary: Reclaims a student submission on behalf of the student that owns it. Reclaiming a student submission transfers ownership of attached Drive files to the student and updates the submission state.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions return
commands.summary: Returns a student submission. Returning a student submission transfers ownership of attached Drive files to the student and may also update the submission state.

commands.command: gws classroom courses courseWork studentSubmissions turnIn
commands.summary: Turns in a student submission. Turning in a student submission transfers ownership of attached Drive files to the teacher and may also update the submission state.
Updates a rubric. See google.classroom.v1.Rubric for details of which fields can be updated. Rubric update capabilities are limited once grading has started.

Creates a student group for a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to create the student group or for access errors.
Deletes a student group. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to delete the requested student group or for access errors.
Returns a list of groups in a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `NOT_FOUND` if the course does not exist.

Operations on the 'students' resource
Adds a user as a student of a course. Domain administrators are permitted to directly add users within their domain as students to courses within their domain.
Deletes a student of a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to delete students of this course or for access errors.
Returns a student of a course. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to view students of this course or for access errors.

Removes the specified teacher from the specified course.

Returns a list of teachers of this course that the requester is permitted to view. This method returns the following error codes: * `NOT_FOUND` if the course does not exist.

Returns a topic. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to access the requested course or topic, or for access errors.
Returns the list of topics that the requester is permitted to view.
Updates one or more fields of a topic.
Updates a course. Note: Unlike other fields, `levels` is not cleared if omitted from the request.
Updates grading period settings of a course. Individual grading periods can be added, removed, or modified using this method.

Creates an invitation. Only one invitation for a user and course may exist at a time. Delete and re-create an invitation to make changes.
Deletes an invitation. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to delete the requested invitation or for access errors.
Returns an invitation. This method returns the following error codes: * `PERMISSION_DENIED` if the requesting user is not permitted to view the requested invitation or for access errors.

The Google Drive API allows clients to access resources from Google Drive.

Operations on the 'about' resource
Gets information about the user, the user's Drive, and system capabilities. For more information, see Return user info. Required: The `fields` parameter must be set.

Retrieves an access proposal by ID. For more information, see Manage pending access proposals.
List the access proposals on a file. For more information, see Manage pending access proposals. Note: Only approvers are able to list access proposals on a file.
Approves or denies an access proposal. For more information, see Manage pending access proposals.
Operations on the 'approvals' resource
Approves an approval. For more information, see Manage approvals. This is used to update the ReviewerResponse of the requesting user with a Response of `APPROVED`.
Cancels an approval. For more information, see Manage approvals. Updates the approval Status to `CANCELLED`.
Comments on an approval. For more information, see Manage approvals. This sends a notification to both the initiator and the reviewers.
Declines an approval. For more information, see Manage approvals. This is used to update the ReviewerResponse of the requesting user with a Response of `DECLINED`.
Gets an approval by ID. For more information, see Manage approvals.
Lists the approvals on a file. For more information, see Manage approvals.
Reassigns the reviewers on an approval. For more information, see Manage approvals. Adds or replaces reviewers in the ReviewerResponse of the approval.
Starts an approval on a file. For more information, see Manage approvals.
Operations on the 'apps' resource
Gets a specific app. For more information, see Return user info.
Lists a user's installed apps. For more information, see Return user info.
Operations on the 'changes' resource
Gets the starting pageToken for listing future changes. For more information, see Retrieve changes.
Lists the changes for a user or shared drive. For more information, see Retrieve changes.
Subscribes to changes for a user. For more information, see Notifications for resource changes.

Stops watching resources through this channel. For more information, see Notifications for resource changes.

Deletes a comment. For more information, see Manage comments and replies.
Gets a comment by ID. For more information, see Manage comments and replies. Required: The `fields` parameter must be set. To return the exact fields you need, see Return specific fields.
Lists a file's comments. For more information, see Manage comments and replies. Required: The `fields` parameter must be set. To return the exact fields you need, see Return specific fields.
Updates a comment with patch semantics. For more information, see Manage comments and replies. Required: The `fields` parameter must be set.
Operations on the 'drives' resource
Creates a shared drive. For more information, see Manage shared drives.
Permanently deletes a shared drive for which the user is an `organizer`. The shared drive cannot contain any untrashed items. For more information, see Manage shared drives.

Operations on the 'tasks' resource
Clears all completed tasks from the specified task list. The affected tasks will be marked as 'hidden' and no longer be returned by default when retrieving all tasks for a task list.
Deletes the specified task from the task list. If the task is assigned, both the assigned task and the original task (in Docs, Chat Spaces) are deleted.
Returns the specified task.
Creates a new task on the specified task list. Tasks assigned from Docs or Chat Spaces cannot be inserted from Tasks Public API; they can only be created by assigning them from Docs or Chat Spaces.
Returns all tasks in the specified task list. Doesn't return assigned tasks by default (from Docs, Chat Spaces).
Moves the specified task to another position in the destination task list. If the destination list is not specified, the task is moved within its current list.
Updates the specified task. This method supports patch semantics.
Updates the specified task.
